NLL = - Σ (y_true * log(p_predicted) + (1 - y_true) * log(1 - p_predicted))

where y_true is the one-hot encoded next character and p_predicted comes from the neural net's logits. Lower NLL means better alignment between the model's predictions and the observed data.
